incidents.name: ATMToken auto-dump transfer branch
incidents.notes: ATMToken._transfer()'s sell branch dumps 20% of every sell size out of the contract's own ATM reserves into the pair at amountOutMin = 0, and its anti-whale guards key only on the sender's fresh per-address state, so 30 farmer clones drained the ATM/USDT pair.

sources.ref: onchain review: ATM 0x986058ec93756E57b4e55b406dD0BeE24bcD95e3 created 2026-01-01 by 0xbe8351c14e5108a57a545dfa8669fa31aa6adc68, unrelated to attack sender 0x7e7c1f0d567c0483f85e1d016718e44414cdbafe; no EIP-1967 upgrade events; setup tx 0x3738909da7960d72efc2635d73aff5f15ef14a1b18ee0281abaa3d4c94adc69b, drain tx measured here; victim pair 0x659b44d603052132fd36cf048d9e0ba1e307ae3a
